# CodeCrafter — Moshe Schwartzberg

Official website: https://mosheschwartzberg.com/
English: https://mosheschwartzberg.com/en/
Business: CodeCrafter, founded and run by Moshe Schwartzberg.
Languages: Hebrew and English. Primary market: Israel; remote projects can be discussed internationally.

CodeCrafter designs and develops business websites, landing pages, online stores, CRM and internal software, APIs, integrations, and workflow automations. Projects are scoped to real needs, access rights, migration constraints, testing, and maintainability. A particular outcome, ranking, timeline, integration, or ROI is not guaranteed without evidence.
